name: CI/CD Pipeline for Club Website

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  #push:
  #  branches: [ main, dev ]
  #  workflow_dispatch:
  #pull_request:
  #  branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  Build_and_Test:
    runs-on: [self-hosted]

    steps:
    # 1. Checkout the code repository
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    # 2. Set up Docker Buildx (best practice for caching layers)
    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

    # 3. Build the container image locally for testing
    - name: Build Docker image
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
      with:
        context: .
        load: true
        tags: devops-app:test
        #cache-from: type=gha
        #cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
        #Gemini suggested removing this.
    # 4. Run the Django test suite inside the built container
    - name: Run Basic pyhton tests
      run: |
        docker run --rm -w /app/my_tennis_club devops-app:test python manage.py test
    - name: Run Tests and Generate Coverage
      run: |
       mkdir -p ./coverage_html
       docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)/coverage_html:/app/my_tennis_club/htmlcov" -w /app/my_tennis_club devops-app:test sh -c "coverage run manage.py test && coverage html"
    - name : Run E2E tests
      run: |
       docker run -d \
         --name tennis-app \
         -p 8000:8000 \
         devops-app:test \
         python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000

    - name: Wait for application
      run: |
        timeout 30 bash -c 'until curl http://localhost:8000; do sleep 2; done'

    - name: Run Playwright tests
      run: |
       docker run --rm \
        --network host \
        -w /app/my_tennis_club \
        devops-app:test \
        pytest E2ETests -v

    - name: Upload Coverage HTML Artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: code-coverage-report
        path: ./coverage_html/

    #cleanup.
    - name: Post-job Docker Cleanup
      if: always()  # CRITICAL: Ensures this runs even if the build or tests fail
      run: |
        echo "Cleaning up Docker resources..."
        docker system prune -af --volumes
#    - name: Run Basic pyhton tests
#      run: |
#        docker run --rm -w /app/my_tennis_club devops-app:test python manage.py test
#        docker run --rm -w /app/my_tennis_club devops-app:test coverage run manage.py test
#        docker run --rm -w /app/my_tennis_club devops-app:test coverage report
